title: The World Revolving Disc 13
description: This resource pack adds The World Revolving (song) from the Jevil boss fight in place of the "13" music disc as well as giving the disc a Jevil style texture. (the audio and character are both from Deltarune)
body: This resource pack adds The World Revolving (song) from the Jevil boss fight in place of the "13" music disc as well as giving the disc a Jevil style texture. (the audio and character are both from Deltarune) and this is just a beta :3
